changelog: Two rejection reasons: Duplicate (the same review posted twice) and Test review (one the store posted to try the site). They're offered on the reject screen, the REST route and the moderate-review ability, logged and shown like the other six, translated for fr_CA, and named in "About our reviews".
The moderation pages have a title: "Reject a review", "Redact a review" and so on, in place of the site's name alone (WCAG 2.4.2).
On WordPress's Edit Comment screen, a published or waiting review's Move to Trash link, which led to a refusal, is replaced by its Reject link.
The readme's security contact is zach.atkinson85@gmail.com. 1.0.7 gave a no-reply address that can't receive a report.
